references.text: Jesus healed many who were possessed by demons and did not allow the demons to speak because they knew him.
Jesus healed all kinds of diseases and afflictions among the people.
Jesus healed all who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons.
A large crowd followed Jesus because they saw the signs he performed on the sick.
The apostles healed many sick people and those troubled by unclean spirits.
Many who were possessed by evil spirits were healed.
